For the Petitioner :- Mr. Piyush Kumar Roy, Advocate For the State :- Mr. Achinto Sen, Advocate

14/05.12.2023

Heard Mr. Piyush Kumar Roy, the learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Achinto
Sen, the learned counsel for the respondent State.

2. This petition has been filed for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding arising out of
C-Iv-12/09 under section 16 (1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, pending in the
court of learned S.D.J.M., Ranchi.

3.  The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the license was issued in the name of the proprietor and the petitioner cannot be held criminally liable under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
He submits that the case against the petitioner is not made out under section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
4. The learned counsel for the respondent State submits that this petitioner was named as licensee which is evident from the license brought on the record by way of filing counter affidavit.

He submits that the said license was renewed from 27.4.2007 to 31.3.2012 and the said allegations are Tuhin Mukherjee vs The State Of Jharkhand And Another .... ... on 5 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138179461/
1 of the year 2009.

entities.text: Tuhin Mukherjee vs The State Of Jharkhand And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that during that period the petitioner was the licensee.
On these grounds he submits that no case of interference is made out.

5. It appears that there are allegations against the petitioner and others of Paneer and R-pure haldi power were not found to be in consonance with the standard of quality laid down under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and the analyst report is there dated 18.04.2009.
Further one of co-accused has moved before this Court in Cr.M.P. No.1321 of 2010 which was dismissed as withdrawn and the said accused was seller whereas the petitioner was the licensee.
Thus, what has been argued by the learned court for the petitioner that can be the subject matter of trial only.
Further, in license the name of the petitioner is shown for the period from 27.4.2007 to 31.03.2012 and the allegation is of the year 2009.
No case of interference is made out.
7. Pending petition if any also stands dismissed.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/,
